contexts.text: Chaff () = things in which there is nothing of good.
What a man merely thinks, and does not act... is dissipated like chaff by a breath of wind...
Like a husk or chaff relatively to the kernels.
Fodder is the food of donkeys, and consists of straw and chaff; hence it = all reflection about scientifics...
Like chaff in the wind... AC 6631:end. AC 8002:2.

Ye shall not add to give chaff to the people () = the lowest scientifics, and the most general of all. Chaff, or straw = scientific truths; and in fact the lowest scientifics and the most general ones of all; for the lowest of all foods in a spiritual sense is straw or chaff, because it is that of beasts. Explained.

I will give you no chaff whatever () = that there will no longer be the most general scientifics from that source... Chaff = the most general scientifics of all. AC 7127:end. AC 7128. AC 7134. AC 7144.
(My former ideas) were separated like chaff from the wheat...
Which on being pounded yields only chaff...
By the chaff which He shall burn up with unquenchable fire () is signified falsity of every kind which is from an infernal origin, and which will be destroyed; thus those who are in that falsity.
As the faith of falsity is like chaff before the wind, it is said that Satan hath demanded them, to sift them as wheat (); wheat = the good of charity separated from the chaff.
